title: File:1515 Third Street.jpg
desc: An office building at 1515 Third Street in the Mission Bay neighborhood of San Francisco, California.  At the time this photo was taken, this building was home to the headquarters of OpenAI.  Photographed by user Coolcaesar on June 15, 2025.

title: File:ALMA's Array Operations Site (dji 0148-cc).tiff
desc: Two groups of people stand in front of the ALMA Array Operations Site (AOS), 30 kilometers from San Pedro de Atacama, and at 2900 meters above sea level. The Chajnantor Plateau softly lies behind them.
